jobs.description_snippet: **Job Description** Product Support Engineer (PSE) Job Function: Programs & Services Business Unit: Wabtec Digital Mine Reports to: Service Support Manager, Digital Mine Location: Johannesburg **About the job** Join our Program & Services team at Wabtec Digital Mine, a rapidly growing services function in a Mining Technology business dedicated to delivering world class services to our clients. PSE’s are a critical interface to customers of the Digital Mine business – they are essential to customers achieving the safety and productivity outcomes needed. You will work closely with the Product Management and Engineering teams, advocating for the customer in prioritization discussions. You will be an early adopter of new technology, with your feedback helping to shape ongoing development improvements. **How will yo make a difference?** **Position Responsibilities** * Configure the system as appropriate to operate according to agreed customer requirements * Perform testing / verification of system operation and performance for configured systems * Work with services team to ensure successful deployment of new systems * Work with customers to deliver ongoing configuration changes to the system, ensuring adherence with customer change management requirements * Support firmware, software and configuration updates to ensure the system operates as required * Perform services as defined by Service Level Agreements or as part of project execution, remotely, in the office or on site as required * Own and provide technical support for our customers and partners to ensure customer satisfaction and successful outcomes * Engage with Product Managers to advocate for the customer in terms of quality, functionality and prioritization **What we need to know about you?** We are looking for a dedicated and personable Product Support Engineer to provide technical services and product support to customers using products in the Digital Mine portfolio. This includes CAS (Collision Awareness System) and DGS (Drill Guidance System) as well as other products that are added or developed in the future. **Required Skills** * Experience with Linux administration, Microsoft Server, IIS and SQL Server * Coding exposure to C, C++, Python, Java, HTML or similar * Sound knowledge of current network and communications technology * Ability to read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams * Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, problem solve and manage resolution to technical system issues * Able to manage and prioritise simultaneous demands in accordance with agreed key performance objectives * Excellent oral and written communication skills, with a high level of attention to detail * Customer service focused, with a strong work ethic and ability to work unsupervised * Good interpersonal and teamwork skills and ability to develop effective customer relationships * Commitment to working safely and ensuring compliance with relevant policies, procedures and legislation **Desirable:** * Tertia
jobs.blurb: Product Support Engineer interfacing with Digital Mine customers to configure systems, perform testing, and advocate for customer needs in product development discussions.

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer
jobs.description_snippet: We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to help evolve HyperDev’s AI developer platform. You’ll build and improve the interfaces developers use to express ideas, interact with AI, review changes and stay in control of their code. Working closely with the founders and engineering team, you’ll deliver new features, refine existing workflows and strengthen the frontend as the product grows. You’ll contribute to technical decisions, improve shared components and help maintain a consistent, reliable user experience. This role suits someone who combines strong React and TypeScript skills with attention to usability and visual detail. You should enjoy understanding an existing product, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking features from concept through to release. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build and improve responsive, accessible interfaces using React and TypeScript. * Work with the team to translate product priorities and user feedback into clear workflows and polished interactions. * Evolve the existing frontend architecture, reusable components and shared UI patterns. * Improve interfaces for AI-assisted development, including streamed responses, progress updates, reviewing generated output and recovering from errors. * Integrate backend and third-party APIs, handling application state, asynchronous updates, loading states and failures. * Deliver new features while maintaining the reliability and consistency of existing functionality. * Identify and resolve usability issues, frontend bugs and performance bottlenecks. * Strengthen frontend test coverage, code quality and release confidence. * Contribute to code reviews and technical decisions, balancing immediate product needs with long-term maintainability. * Use AI coding tools to support development while independently reviewing and validating their output. **About Us** At HyperDev, we don’t believe AI replaces developers. We believe it should make them faster, clearer, and more human. Our platform turns natural language into real, working software while keeping people firmly in the loop. AI generates structure and logic; humans guide intent, judgement, and quality. The result is code that stays understandable, controllable, and owned by the people building it—not a black box you’re afraid to touch. HyperDev is a spin-out within the HyperionDev ecosystem, backed by a profitable global tech education company. Our founding team includes engineers who have worked on generative AI models at OpenAI and technical leaders behind award-winning software products. We’re building tools for developers who want leverage, not autopilot. If you care about craft as much as speed, and you want to shape how humans and AI build software together, you’ll feel at home here. **Requirements** ***Minimum:*** * 4+ years of commercial frontend development experience, with substantial hands-on experience using TypeScript and React. * Strong HTML and CSS skills, including responsive layouts, semantic markup and acc
jobs.blurb: Frontend Software Engineer building responsive, accessible interfaces for HyperDev's AI developer platform with focus on usability and visual detail.

jobs.title: Intermediate SQL Developer (iOCOOO157)
jobs.description_snippet: We’re looking for a skilled SQL Developer to join our growing team at iOCO. In this role, you’ll be responsible for developing new systems, maintaining and enhancing existing solutions, and assisting with day-to-day BAU (Business-As-Usual) work. This opportunity is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their projects, works well independently, and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and high-quality database solutions. **What you’ll do:** * Design, develop, and maintain SQL-based systems and solutions. * Extend and optimize existing database structures and stored procedures. * Support and troubleshoot BAU data processes to ensure consistent system performance. * Collaborate closely with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand and translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Develop and implement efficient queries, scripts, and database objects to meet business needs. * Perform data analysis, validation, and quality checks to ensure data integrity. * Participate in testing, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Take full ownership of assigned projects — from design through to implementation and support. **Your expertise:** * 2+ years’ experience as a SQL Developer in a professional environment. * Proficiency in T-SQL, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and performance tuning is essential. * Experience with SSRS will be beneficial. * Solid understanding of relational database design, normalization, and optimization. * Experience working with large datasets and complex data transformations. * Exposure to source control and Agile methodologies is advantageous. **Key Attributes** * Strong sense of ownership and accountability for deliverables. * Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. * Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. * Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering high-quality work. **Other information applicable to the opportunity:** * Contract position * Location: Johannesburg or Cape Town – hybrid way of work **Why work for us?** Want to work for an organization that solves complex real-world problems with innovative software solutions? At iOCO, we believe anything is possible with modern technology, software, and development expertise. We are continuously pushing the boundaries of innovative solutions across multiple industries using an array of technologies.? You will be part of a consultancy, working with some of the most knowledgeable minds in the industry on interesting solutions across different business domains.? Our culture of continuous learning will ensure that you will have all the opportunities, tools, and support to hone and grow your craft.? By joining IOCO you will have an open invitation to developer inspiring forums. A place where you will be able to connect and learn from and with your peers by sharing ideas, experiences, practices, and solutions.
jobs.blurb: Intermediate SQL Developer responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SQL-based database systems while optimizing existing solutions and supporting BAU processes for a growing tech team.

What We're Looking For * Strong technical troubleshooting and fault-finding skills. * Previous commercial VoIP/PBX support experience. * Good L1/L2 IT support knowledge. * Excellent spoken and written English. * Professional telephone manner and customer service skills. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users. * Ability to take ownership of problems through to resolution. * Comfortable supporting UK-based customers. Desirable Skills * VLANs and Voice VLANs * QoS * Firewall/NAT troubleshooting * Microsoft Azure * Microsoft Intune * PowerShell * Hyper-V * Experience supporting healthcare or dental organisations Why Join Shoreability? * Work with UK customers and Managed Service Providers. * Develop specialist VoIP and IT infrastructure skills. * Work with Asterisk, 3CX, Gamma Horizon and Microsoft technologie

jobs.title: Funnel QA Specialist, DTC E-Commerce (Checkout & Tracking)
jobs.description_snippet: About HarZa Group HarZa Group builds and scales direct-to-consumer health and wellness brands. Our flagship brand is Rejuvacare, with RejuvaKnee as our hero product in chronic pain relief, and we are actively launching new brands across the portfolio. We run entirely on paid digital channels, ship primarily into the United States, and have grown twelve times in a single year with close to 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote-first by design and async-first by default. The Role Every funnel we publish carries paid traffic from the moment it goes live. When something breaks here, it does not break quietly in a staging environment. It breaks while we are spending money on it. The expensive failures in this business are rarely the obvious ones. A page that looks perfect but records the order under the wrong offer. An upsell that charges correctly and then sends the customer to a blank screen. A purchase event that fires twice and quietly corrupts the numbers the media buyer is optimizing against. A downsell path nobody walked, because everybody tested the version where the customer says yes. We are hiring a Funnel QA Specialist to be the person who walks those paths. You will test complete customer journeys rather than pages, inside Checkout Champ and across the funnels built on top of it. You will place test orders, follow every branch including the ones where the customer declines, verify that tracking fires correctly and only once, check the experience on mobile first because that is where our traffic is, and confirm that what went live matches what was approved. And you will do the part that matters more than any individual bug: when the same defect appears for the third time, you stop logging it as a new ticket and change the thing that keeps producing it. What You'll Do **Test the full journey, not the page** * Walk complete funnels end to end before launch: advertorials, landing pages, VSL pages, quizzes, product pages, order forms, checkouts, upsells, downsells, declines and post-purchase flows. * Place test orders in Checkout Champ and validate pricing, offer configuration, order records, confirmation pages and what the customer actually receives. * Test the paths nobody volunteers to test: declined cards, abandoned flows, downsell branches, back-button behaviour, refreshes mid-checkout. * Test mobile first, then desktop, across the browsers our traffic actually uses. **Validate tracking as seriously as you validate checkout** * Confirm page view, add to cart, initiate checkout, purchase and custom events fire, fire once, and carry the correct values. * Use GTM preview, tag assistant and browser network inspection to verify rather than assume. * Flag tracking discrepancies early, because broken tracking corrupts decisions downstream before anyone notices the data is wrong. **Hold the line on quality** * Verify that live pages match approved copy, claims, pricing, imagery and brand standards. * Validate A/B test variations
